import subprocess, json

def act(turn_deg, move_m):
    res = subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/act.py', json.dumps({'turn_deg': turn_deg, 'move_m': move_m})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(res.stdout)
    print(f'Frame {d[\"frame\"]}: turn={turn_deg}, move={move_m}, status={d[\"status\"]}, coll={d[\"collision\"]}')
    return d

# Look further left at vase/plant: turn -60 deg

# Turn right to stool/cabinet/table
act(90, 0)  # Frame 27: heading 330 deg
act(90, 0)  # Frame 28: heading 60 deg
act(45, 0)  # Frame 29: heading 105 deg
